title: A Holiday in Europe
setting: A train station, a plane, and a small hotel in Rome.

characters.name: Leo
characters.look: Leo, a young man with short brown hair and a blue backpack

characters.name: Mia
characters.look: Mia, a young woman with long black hair and a yellow sun hat

sentences.en: Leo and Mia start their holiday at the station.
sentences.zh: 里奥和米娅在车站开始了他们的假期。
sentences.scene_prompt: Leo, a young man with short brown hair and a blue backpack and Mia, a young woman with long black hair and a yellow sun hat wait with suitcases on a busy train platform.

sentences.en: They take a fast train north to France.
sentences.zh: 他们坐快车向北去法国。
sentences.scene_prompt: A sleek train speeds through green fields; Leo, a young man with short brown hair and a blue backpack and Mia, a young woman with long black hair and a yellow sun hat look out of the window.

sentences.en: Then a big aeroplane carries them to Rome.
sentences.zh: 然后一架大飞机把他们送到罗马。
sentences.scene_prompt: A large white aeroplane flies over old red-roofed buildings and a round dome.

sentences.en: They arrive at a small hotel near the river.
sentences.zh: 他们到达河边的一家小旅馆。
sentences.scene_prompt: Leo, a young man with short brown hair and a blue backpack and Mia, a young woman with long black hair and a yellow sun hat pull suitcases up to a small hotel beside a river.

sentences.en: They meet a friendly Australian family there.
sentences.zh: 他们在那里遇到了友好的一家澳大利亚人。
sentences.scene_prompt: Leo, a young man with short brown hair and a blue backpack and Mia, a young woman with long black hair and a yellow sun hat shake hands with a smiling family in the hotel garden; the father wears a wide-brimmed bush hat.

sentences.en: The family is going to Africa by boat.
sentences.scene_prompt: A white boat leaves a sunny harbour; the family waves from the deck.

sentences.en: Mia writes a postcard about the trip.
sentences.zh: 米娅写了一张关于这次旅行的明信片。
sentences.scene_prompt: Mia, a young woman with long black hair and a yellow sun hat writes on a postcard at a café table.

sentences.en: Next week, their plane goes east to Greece.
sentences.zh: 下周，他们的飞机向东飞往希腊。
sentences.scene_prompt: Leo, a young man with short brown hair and a blue backpack and Mia, a young woman with long black hair and a yellow sun hat look out of a plane window at blue sea and white islands.
